contexts.text: They are then driven out with fines.
Thus He expelled the hereditary evil (and the human) from the mother. AC 2107. AC 2159. AC 2204:end. AC 2216:end. AC 2265. AC 2625:end. AC 2632. AC 2816. AC 3025. AC 3036. AC 3599:2. AC 4563.
Sometimes... they want to expel evil. Signified.
To pursue the enemies = to expel evils and falsities...

As to the nations which were to be driven out from the Lord's Kingdom... These things were represented by the nations which were driven out of the Land of Canaan... In like manner by the Jews, who were afterwards driven out thence. And so with many nations of yore, by which the like things were represented, as by the Horites, who were driven out of Mount Seir by the descendants of Esau; and by the Avim who were driven out by the Caphtorites; also by the Emim and Rephaim, who were driven out by the Moabites.
To drive out the nations () = to purge from evils.
The outcasts of Israel () = their truths... The outcasts, the dispersed, the remains, and the residue = the truths and goods which survive.
Under Deborah (Rebekah's nurse), see this reference.
The quality of the Natural as to what was expelled. Signified.
The nature cannot be expelled; and, if it is expelled, nothing of life remains.
With a strong hand he will drive you out of his land () = that with all his force and power he will put them to flight from his neighbourhood... To drive them out = to put them to flight.

He drove them out from the faces of Pharaoh () = that the will of those who were infesting was entirely contrary to truth Divine... For that is driven out which is contrary to the will, or to the affections.
Driving he will drive you out from hence () = that they will feel aversion for and shun their presence... For he who feels aversion for anyone's presence... drives him out from himself.
Because they were driven out by Egypt () = since they were removed by those who were in falsity from evil. To be driven out = to be removed; for he who is driven out, is removed.
My hand shall drive them out () = that by power Heaven will be destroyed. To drive out = to cast down, and thus to destroy.
(The hornet) shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite from before thee () = the flight of falsities from evils. To drive out = to put to flight; thus flight.

I will not drive them out from before thee in one year () = no hurried flight or removal of the falsities and evils which are signified by the nations in the Land of Canaan... For they who are in falsities and evils in the other life, are not driven out, but flee of their own accord.
The reason to drive out, when predicated of evils and falsities, = removal, is that falsities and evils are not driven out by man, but are removed...
By little and little I will drive them out from before thee () = removal by degrees according to order. AC 9343.
I drive out from thy faces the Amorite and the Canaanite, etc () = the removal of evils and thence of falsities. To drive out from the faces = to remove from the interiors. AC 10674.
They are at last driven out from the Societies of Spirits...
That evil Spirits are not expelled, but recede of themselves; for they are obstinate...
Unless this were expelled by the Lord, the whole human race would perish.
The outcasts of Israel = those who are not in truths, but still long to learn them; and the dispersed of Judah = those who are in the good of life, and thereby in love to the Lord.
The outcasts of Israel whom the Lord will gather () = all in the Church who are in truths from good separated by those therein who are in falsities from evil.

The evil with man cannot be expelled, but is removed, because he is not life in himself... But, from the Divine in Himself, the Lord expelled the evil from the mother, wherefore He rose with the whole body... On the cross everything maternal was expelled.
